description: The Influence of Urban Morphologies on the Resilience of the Water Distribution System - Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Imke Rehm (Technical University of Darmstadt). This dataset includes the green field resilient optimal water distribution design for different real and schematic cities. The non parameterized network information of the real cities, which was the input data to this dataset, is accessible at DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17458520. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
